rv.q: London has had to wait 35 years for the arrival of the Broadway hit Dreamgirls - but it has been worth the wait.
Dreamgirls is a musical full of sparkle.
Amber Riley and the cast of this incredible musical blew the roof off London's Savoy Theatre.
Dreamgirls has certainly been worth the wait, exploding onto the Savoy stage with an unbridled megawatt energy that can be felt across London.

Dreamgirls has been a long time coming to the West End. But 35 years after its Broadway premiere and a decade after Bill Condon's Oscar-winning movie whetted Brit appetites, the show proves that in the right hands it really is worth waiting for. The UK debut of the stage show has been a long time coming, but is absolutely worth the wait.

Dreamgirls is not my kind of musical, since my basic taste runs to sophisticated and small scale. This is huge, incredibly noisy and with the emotional impact of a juggernaut. But I couldn't stop smiling with pleasure all the time I was watching it.

cn.t: After a 35-year wait, Dreamgirls explodes onto the West End with megawatt energy and spectacular performances. Critics unanimously agree it's worth the wait, praising its dazzling spectacle and powerhouse vocals.
